fh_cross.name: Cross-court forehand rally
fh_cross.goal: Consistency and depth on the cross-court forehand, the most played diagonal in rallies.
steps: A and B stand on the deuce diagonal, behind the baseline.
They rally with cross-court forehands only, aiming between the service line and the baseline.
Count the shots: the goal is 10 in a row in the zone.
After each series start again from zero and switch who starts.
fh_cross.easier: Play from mid-court, with a slower ball and more height over the net.
fh_cross.harder: The ball must land beyond the service line and no more than a metre from the sideline.
fh_cross.cue: Ball high over the net and away from the lines, deep cross-court.
stepCues: Turn your shoulders early and finish over your shoulder.
fh_cross.missTip: Three out in a row: more margin, aim a metre inside the lines and lift the trajectory.
fh_cross.streakTip: Five in a row: now try hitting harder or closer to the line.

bh_cross.name: Cross-court backhand rally
bh_cross.goal: A safe, deep cross-court backhand, without giving away short balls.
steps: A and B stand on the ad diagonal, behind the baseline.
Only cross-court backhands into the deep zone.
Every short ball (before the service line) resets the count.
Three series of 10 good shots in a row.
bh_cross.easier: When needed you can run around the ball and hit a forehand; rallies of 5 are enough.
bh_cross.harder: Alternate topspin and slice backhands, always cross-court.
bh_cross.cue: Shoulders turned and front foot forward: the ball goes deep cross-court.
stepCues: Prepare the racket early and hit in front of your body.
bh_cross.missTip: Three out in a row: hit further in front and lift the ball a little over the net.
bh_cross.streakTip: Five in a row: now look for more angle.

line_cross.name: One down the line, one cross-court
line_cross.goal: Move along the baseline and change direction: the basis of a real rally.
steps: A always plays down the line, B always cross-court: the ball draws a figure of eight.
After each shot go back towards the centre of the baseline.
After 2 minutes swap roles.
Count how many shots in a row you can keep.
line_cross.easier: Slower, higher ball; two bounces are allowed.
line_cross.harder: Whoever misses the direction loses the point; play to 7.
line_cross.cue: Down the line first, then cross-court: decide the direction before you hit.
stepCues: Down the line: shoulders lined up with the line and follow through to the target.
Now cross-court: hit a little earlier, in front of your body.
line_cross.missTip: Three out in a row: down the line crosses the higher part of the net, keep more margin.
line_cross.streakTip: Five in a row: now change direction without giving it away.

deep_rally.name: Deep rally
deep_rally.goal: Get used to hitting long: every ball beyond the service line.
steps: A and B in the middle, behind the baseline.
Free rally, but every ball must land between the service line and the baseline.
A short ball gives the other a point: play to 11.
deep_rally.easier: A ball just short of the service line is fine too.
deep_rally.harder: Smaller zone: the last metre and a half before the baseline.
deep_rally.cue: Deep ball through the middle, beyond the service line.
stepCues: Swing low to high and send the ball high over the net.
deep_rally.missTip: Three out in a row: less power, more spin and more height.
deep_rally.streakTip: Five in a row: now make it land closer to the baseline.

mini_tennis.name: Mini tennis
mini_tennis.goal: Feel the ball and control it: to warm up or for beginners.
steps: A and B inside the service boxes, near the net.
Soft rally: the ball must stay in the boxes.
Three to five minutes of forehands and backhands, then a few volleys.
If you like, count the rallies or play points to 11.
mini_tennis.easier: Low-pressure ball (red or orange) and two bounces allowed.
mini_tennis.harder: Only slices, or only volleys without letting the ball bounce.
mini_tennis.cue: Soft shots inside the service boxes, under control.
stepCues: Short swing and a steady racket at contact.
mini_tennis.missTip: Three out in a row: slow down, open the face and guide the ball.
mini_tennis.streakTip: Five in a row: now alternate forehand and backhand.

serve_targets.name: Serve to three targets
serve_targets.goal: Vary the direction of the serve: down the T, at the body, wide.
steps: Put three cones in the service box: near the T, in the middle and near the sideline.
Serve 5 balls to each cone from the deuce side, then from the ad side.
Mark in or out on every serve: the app counts the percentage per target.
Aim for accuracy first, then add a little speed.
serve_targets.easier: Serve from mid-court, or try only two targets (T and wide).
serve_targets.harder: Only one ball per target, in rotation: T, body, wide, without repeating.
serve_targets.cue: Same toss for every target: only the direction changes.
stepCues: Down the T: aim at the centre line.
At the body: aim at the receiver's hip.
Wide: open the angle towards the sideline.
Now from the left, down the T.
From the left, at the body.
From the left, wide: open the angle.
serve_targets.missTip: Three out in a row: check your toss, it must always be in the same place.
serve_targets.streakTip: Five in a row: now aim closer to the lines.

second_serve.name: Second serve with margin
second_serve.goal: A safe second serve: more spin, high over the net and deep.
steps: Serve second serves only, towards the back of the service box.
Look for a high path over the net that drops into the deep zone.
Ten serves per side, marking in or out.
Goal: at least 8 out of 10 in.
second_serve.easier: Anywhere in the box is fine: margin over the net is what counts.
second_serve.harder: Zone reduced to the deepest third of the box, towards the receiver's backhand.
second_serve.cue: Kick second serve: lots of spin, the ball clears the net high.
stepCues: From the right: brush the ball from low to high.
Now from the left: same motion, loose arm.
second_serve.missTip: Three out in a row: more spin, not more power, and toss a little above your head.
second_serve.streakTip: Five in a row: now try to make it bounce deeper.

return_deep.name: Deep return through the middle
return_deep.goal: Return long and through the middle, to take angles away from the server.
steps: B serves from the deuce side, A returns from the other end.
A aims for the deep central zone: no risks on the lines.
After 10 returns switch serving side, then swap roles.
Count the returns in the zone.
return_deep.easier: B serves more slowly, or only second serves.
return_deep.harder: After the return the point is played: a return in the zone counts double.
return_deep.cue: Deep return through the middle: short, compact swing.
stepCues: Split step when the server hits, then block the ball in front.
return_deep.missTip: Three out in a row: shorten the swing and aim at the middle, away from the lines.
return_deep.streakTip: Five in a row: now try to open the angle.

volley_feed.name: Forehand and backhand volleys
volley_feed.goal: Firm, accurate volleys with a steady racket face.
steps: A at the net, one step inside the service line; the coach feeds from the middle of the other half.
The balls come one to the right and one to the left: forehand volley, then backhand.
Every volley goes cross-court and deep.
Two series of 10 per side.
volley_feed.easier: Balls fed by hand, slowly, at shoulder height.
volley_feed.harder: Faster, lower balls; after each volley one step back and forward again.
volley_feed.cue: Firm volleys: steady racket face, no backswing.
stepCues: Forehand volley: racket in front, hit with a step forward.
Now backhand volley: shoulder turned and firm wrist.
volley_feed.missTip: Three out in a row: block the ball in front of your body, no backswing.
volley_feed.streakTip: Five in a row: now look for more depth.

approach_volley.name: Approach and volley
approach_volley.goal: Recognise the short ball, attack and finish at the net.
steps: The coach feeds a short ball to A.
A moves in, approaches down the line and keeps going to the net.
As the coach hits, A split-steps, then plays a cross-court volley.
Go back to the baseline and repeat: 10 times.
approach_volley.easier: Slow, high short ball; the volley is played to the middle.
approach_volley.harder: The coach alternates passing shot down the line and lob: A must read and choose.
approach_volley.cue: Approach down the line, move in and finish with the volley.
stepCues: After the approach stop with a split step, then volley cross-court.
approach_volley.missTip: Three out in a row: stop before the volley, don't hit on the run.
approach_volley.streakTip: Five in a row: now try to get closer to the net.

smash.name: Overhead
smash.goal: Move back with the right steps and hit the overhead in balance.
steps: A touches the net with the racket, then moves back sideways.
The coach lifts a lob towards the service line.
A hits the overhead to the marked zone and goes back to the net.
Ten overheads, then change zone.
smash.easier: Lower lobs closer to the net; A starts already side-on.
smash.harder: Deeper lobs: A hits a jump smash and goes straight back to the net.

one_vs_two.name: One at the net against two
one_vs_two.goal: Reflexes and net position under pressure.
steps: A at the net, B and C at the baseline, each on one half.
B and C play to A, who volleys towards the other one.
The balls alternate: forehand and backhand, high and low.
After 2 minutes someone else goes to the net.
one_vs_two.easier: B and C play slowly and towards A.
one_vs_two.harder: B and C may try a passing shot or a lob: the point is played.
one_vs_two.cue: One volley per side: watch who hits and stop before.
stepCues: Forehand volley: steady face and the ball towards the other player.
Now backhand volley: shoulder turned, hit in front.
one_vs_two.missTip: Three out in a row: less power, just try to send it back in.
one_vs_two.streakTip: Five in a row: now look for the gap between the two.

drop_recover.name: Drop shot and recovery
drop_recover.goal: Sprint forward to the short ball and get back into position.
steps: A starts from the centre of the baseline, B plays near the net.
B plays a drop shot, A sprints and plays it back cross-court.
A goes straight back to the baseline, sideways or backwards.
Eight repetitions, then swap roles.
drop_recover.easier: Longer, slower drop shot; A may start from mid-court.
drop_recover.harder: After the recovery B lifts a lob: A runs back and plays it.
drop_recover.cue: Run to the short ball, hit and get straight back.
stepCues: Get low on your legs and play a short cross-court ball.
drop_recover.missTip: Three out in a row: get to the ball sooner and bend your legs more.
drop_recover.streakTip: Five in a row: now run back faster.

spider.name: The spider
spider.goal: Speed and changes of direction towards every part of the court.
steps: Put five cones: the two corners of the baseline, the two service-line corners and the T.
From the centre of the baseline run to the first cone, touch it and come back to the centre.
Then to the second, and so on up to the fifth.
Three rounds, with 1-2 minutes of rest between rounds.
spider.easier: Walk fast instead of running, or use only three cones.
spider.harder: With the racket in hand and a shadow stroke at every cone; time yourself.

split_step.name: Split step
split_step.goal: Be ready: a small hop while the other player hits.
steps: A in the centre of the baseline, the coach feeds from the other half.
When the coach hits, A makes a small hop with feet apart.
As soon as A lands, A goes to the ball and plays it.
After each shot back to the centre: 15 alternating balls.
split_step.easier: Balls fed by hand and announced beforehand (right or left).
split_step.harder: The coach picks side and depth at random.

baseline_shuffle.name: Side steps on the baseline
baseline_shuffle.goal: Short, quick lateral movement, without crossing the feet.
steps: Put three cones: in the centre of the baseline and in the two singles corners.
From the centre, side-step to one corner: touch the cone and come back.
Then the other corner; one round is 4 touches.
Three series of 30 seconds with 1 minute of rest.
baseline_shuffle.harder: With the racket in hand and a shadow stroke at every cone.

serve_plus_one.name: Serve plus one
serve_plus_one.goal: Prepare the shot after the serve: open the court and finish on the other side.
steps: A serves wide from the deuce side.
B returns towards the middle.
A steps in and plays the forehand into the other half, away from B.
Then the point is played; ten serves and swap roles.
serve_plus_one.easier: B returns slowly to the middle and the point is not played.
serve_plus_one.harder: B returns wherever they like: A must choose the right shot.
serve_plus_one.cue: Serve wide, then the forehand into the open court.
stepCues: Serve wide from the right and get ready for the next shot straight away.
serve_plus_one.missTip: Three out in a row: less angle, aim a little further inside the box.
serve_plus_one.streakTip: Five in a row: now count the forehand after the serve too.

cross_points.name: Cross-court points only
cross_points.goal: Patience and shot choice in a smaller space.
steps: Play only in the diagonal half of the singles court.
Start with an underhand feed, then a free point inside the diagonal.
Whoever sends the ball outside the diagonal loses the point.
Games to 11, then change diagonal.
cross_points.harder: After three shots you may also play down the line, but only for a winner.
cross_points.cue: Cross-court points only: patience and a deep ball.
stepCues: Play cross-court with margin and wait for the short ball to attack.
cross_points.missTip: Three out in a row: no rush, send the ball back high and deep.
cross_points.streakTip: Five in a row: now look for a sharper angle.

king_court.name: King of the court
king_court.goal: Play points under pressure, like in a match, even with many players.
steps: A is the king and stays on their side; B challenges from the other side, C and D wait outside.
One point is played: if the challenger wins, they take the king's place.
Whoever loses goes out and the next in line comes in.
Play 10-15 minutes: the winner is whoever scores most points as king.
king_court.easier: Every point starts with an easy underhand feed by the challenger.
king_court.harder: The king must win two points in a row to stay.

doubles_poach.name: Doubles: the poach
doubles_poach.goal: Play as a pair: the net player intercepts the cross-court return.
steps: A1 serves and A2 is at the net; B1 returns cross-court, B2 stands on the service line.
Before the serve A1 and A2 decide whether A2 poaches.
A2 moves when B1 hits, intercepts and finishes between the two opponents.
A1 covers the side left open; ten serves, then rotate.
doubles_poach.easier: No serve: the coach feeds the return ball.
doubles_poach.harder: B1 may return down the line: A2 must move at the right moment.

fh_inside_out.name: Inside-out forehand
fh_inside_out.goal: Run around the backhand and control the rally with a cross-court forehand into the other player's ad side.
steps: A starts from the centre of the baseline; the coach feeds to A's backhand.
A moves left with quick side steps, leaving the ball on their right.
Deep cross-court forehand towards the ad side of the other half.
After the shot, a short recovery: one step towards the centre, no more.
fh_inside_out.easier: The ball comes slowly and already a little to the left: half a step is enough to run around it.
fh_inside_out.harder: The ball comes faster and closer to the centre; the forehand must land beyond the service line.
fh_inside_out.cue: Run around the backhand and hit cross-court into the ad side.
stepCues: Quick feet, leave the ball on your right and finish towards the corner.
fh_inside_out.missTip: Three out in a row: move earlier, so you hit in front without stretching.
fh_inside_out.streakTip: Five in a row: now look for more depth and more angle.

fh_inside_in.name: Inside-in forehand
fh_inside_in.goal: Change direction with the forehand from the ad side: down the line, when the other expects cross-court.
steps: As in the inside-out: A runs around the ball fed to their backhand.
Same preparation, but the forehand goes down the line, close to the left line of the other half.
After the shot A goes back towards the centre: down the line opens the court for the other player.
Series of 10, then rest.
fh_inside_in.easier: Bigger target, away from the line; slow feed.
fh_inside_in.harder: The coach calls "in" or "out" at the last moment: on "in" cross-court, on "out" down the line.
fh_inside_in.cue: Run around the ball, but this time down the line.
stepCues: Prepare as for cross-court and finish towards the line.
fh_inside_in.missTip: Three out in a row: down the line crosses the higher part of the net, keep more margin.
fh_inside_in.streakTip: Five in a row: now hit a little harder, without losing the direction.

fh_topspin_height.name: Heavy, deep forehand
fh_topspin_height.goal: Put spin on the forehand: ball high over the net that drops in and bounces high.
steps: A at the baseline, the coach feeds comfortable balls to the forehand.
Swing from low to high, racket finishing over the shoulder.
The ball must clear the net by a couple of metres and land beyond the service line.
Count how many land in the deep zone out of 20.
fh_topspin_height.easier: Start from mid-court, with less distance and less power.
fh_topspin_height.harder: Alternate one high, heavy ball and one flat ball, always in the deep zone.
fh_topspin_height.cue: Low to high: ball high over the net and deep.
stepCues: Brush the ball and finish with the racket over your shoulder.
fh_topspin_height.missTip: Three out in a row: more spin and less power, the ball has to come down.
fh_topspin_height.streakTip: Five in a row: now try to make it bounce closer to the baseline.

fh_run_wide.name: Forehand on the run
fh_run_wide.goal: Reach the wide ball in balance, send it back cross-court and get straight back to the centre.
steps: A starts from the centre of the baseline.
The coach feeds wide to the forehand: A runs, stops and hits cross-court.
Straight after the shot, back to the centre with side steps.
Series of 6 balls, then a minute of rest.
fh_run_wide.easier: Less wide ball, with more time between feeds.
fh_run_wide.harder: The feed comes while A is still recovering; the forehand must land beyond the service line.
fh_run_wide.cue: Run, stop and hit cross-court, then back to the centre.
stepCues: Small last steps to arrive balanced, then a cross-court shot with margin.
fh_run_wide.missTip: Three out in a row: you are late, start earlier and hit more cross-court.
fh_run_wide.streakTip: Five in a row: now get back to the centre faster.

fh_short_angle.name: Short-angle forehand
fh_short_angle.goal: Pull the other player off the court with a short, sharp cross-court ball.
steps: A and B rally cross-court on the deuce diagonal.
When the ball comes comfortably, A plays the short cross-court that leaves the court near the net.
B runs and tries to get it back: the rally continues.
After 10 angles swap roles.
fh_short_angle.easier: The angle is played only on a ball fed by hand, standing still.
fh_short_angle.harder: The angle is played only on a deep ball, not a comfortable one.
fh_short_angle.cue: Short, sharp cross-court: the ball leaves the court near the net.
stepCues: Hit further in front and close the wrist towards the corner.
fh_short_angle.missTip: Three out in a row: less power and more spin, the ball must drop early.
fh_short_angle.streakTip: Five in a row: now try it off a deeper ball.

fh_approach_line.name: Forehand approach on the short ball
fh_approach_line.goal: Recognise the short ball, move into the court and attack down the line.
steps: A starts from the baseline; the coach feeds a short ball to the forehand.
A moves in, hits moving forward, down the line and deep.
After the approach, A keeps going to the net and stops with a split step.
Series of 8, going back to the baseline each time.
fh_approach_line.easier: Short, high ball that stays in the air longer.
fh_approach_line.harder: After the approach the coach plays a passing shot: A must finish with the volley.
fh_approach_line.cue: Move in and attack down the line, then go to the net.
stepCues: Hit while walking forward, down the line and deep.
fh_approach_line.missTip: Three out in a row: slow the approach down, depth matters more than power.
fh_approach_line.streakTip: Five in a row: now the approach must land near the baseline.

bh_line.name: Backhand down the line
bh_line.goal: A safe backhand down the line from the ad side, without opening the body too much.
steps: A on the baseline, ad side; the coach feeds to the backhand.
Shoulders turned and shot down the line to the deep target.
After every shot, one recovery step towards the centre.
Three series of 10.
bh_line.easier: Wider target, away from the line.
bh_line.harder: Alternate one cross-court and one down-the-line backhand, always deep.
bh_line.cue: Shoulders turned, deep down the line.
stepCues: Keep your shoulders closed until contact and follow through towards the line.
bh_line.missTip: Three out in a row: keep more margin from the line and clear the net higher.
bh_line.streakTip: Five in a row: now aim closer to the sideline.

bh_slice.name: Slice backhand
bh_slice.goal: Slice backhand low over the net and deep, that stays low after the bounce.
steps: The coach feeds to A's backhand, balls at medium height.
Racket high in the preparation, swing from high and forward, face slightly open.
The ball skims low over the net and lands deep.
Count how many land in the zone out of 20.
bh_slice.harder: Alternate a deep slice and a short slice that dies after the net.
bh_slice.cue: Slice low over the net and deep.
stepCues: Start with the racket high and guide the ball forward, not down.
bh_slice.missTip: Three out in a row: follow through more forward and less downward.
bh_slice.streakTip: Five in a row: now try to keep it even lower over the net.

bh_cross_line.name: Backhand cross-court and down the line
bh_cross_line.goal: Change direction with the backhand without changing the preparation.
steps: Step 1: the coach feeds to the backhand and A plays cross-court.
Step 2: same ball, A plays down the line.
The preparation is the same in both cases: only the contact point changes.
10 cross-court, then 10 down the line.
bh_cross_line.easier: Change direction every 10 shots, always slowly.
bh_cross_line.harder: The coach calls the direction while the ball is in the air.
stepCues: Cross-court: hit a little earlier, in front of your body.
Now down the line: hit a little later, shoulders closed.
bh_cross_line.missTip: Three out in a row: slow down and think only about the direction.
bh_cross_line.streakTip: Five in a row: now increase the speed a little.

bh_defense.name: Defensive backhand
bh_defense.goal: When pushed into the corner, send back a high, deep ball to win time to retake the centre.
steps: A starts from the centre; the coach feeds deep and wide to the backhand.
A runs into the corner and plays a high, deep ball to the middle.
While the ball is in the air, A goes back to the centre.
Series of 6 balls.
bh_defense.easier: Less wide ball; just send it back in, high.
bh_defense.harder: A's ball must land beyond the service line, and the coach feeds the next one straight away.
bh_defense.cue: Pushed into the corner: high and deep, then back to the centre.
stepCues: Reach the ball, lift it well over the net and get straight back to the centre.
bh_defense.missTip: Three out in a row: don't look for power, only height and the middle of the court.
bh_defense.streakTip: Five in a row: now make the ball land deeper.

bh_short_angle.name: Short-angle backhand
bh_short_angle.goal: Open the court with the short cross-court backhand on the ad diagonal.
steps: A and B rally with backhands on the ad diagonal.
On a comfortable ball A plays the short, sharp cross-court.
B chases and gets it back: the rally continues.
After 10 angles swap roles.
bh_short_angle.easier: The angle is played on a ball fed by hand.
bh_short_angle.harder: Deep balls only: the angle must be built, not given away.
stepCues: Hit in front and close towards the corner near the net.
bh_short_angle.missTip: Three out in a row: less power, more spin: the ball must drop early.
bh_short_angle.streakTip: Five in a row: now try to tighten the angle even more.

bh_first.name: First backhands
bh_first.goal: Learn the backhand standing still: shoulders turned, contact in front, ball over the net.
steps: A stands inside the court, just behind the service line.
The coach hand-feeds slow balls to the backhand, from near the net.
A turns the shoulders, hits in front of the body and sends the ball into the other half.
Series of 10, with a pause to correct.
bh_first.easier: Let the ball bounce twice, or hit it off a cone.
bh_first.harder: A moves one step before each shot; the ball must land beyond the service line.
bh_first.cue: Shoulders turned and contact in front.
stepCues: Turn your shoulders as soon as you see the ball and hit in front of your body.
bh_first.missTip: Three out in a row: hit more gently and guide the ball upwards.
bh_first.streakTip: Five in a row: now try to send it further.

serve_ad_targets.name: Serve from the left to the targets
serve_ad_targets.goal: Serve from the ad side down the T and wide with the same toss.
steps: A serves from the left.
Step 1: 10 first serves down the T.
Step 2: 10 first serves wide, towards the sideline.
Count how many end up in the target.
serve_ad_targets.easier: Bigger targets: the whole half of the box.
serve_ad_targets.harder: Alternate one serve down the T and one wide, without changing the toss.
serve_ad_targets.cue: From the left: same toss, two directions.
stepCues: Down the T: aim at the centre line.
Now wide: open the angle towards the sideline.
serve_ad_targets.missTip: Three out in a row: check your toss, it must always be in the same place.
serve_ad_targets.streakTip: Five in a row: now aim closer to the lines.

serve_toss.name: First serves
serve_toss.goal: A complete, simple serve: steady toss, ball hit high, inside the box.
steps: First just the toss: the ball goes up and falls in front of the left foot, without hitting.
Then the full serve, slowly, from the right.
After 10 from the right, 10 from the left.
The ball in counts, not the speed.
serve_toss.easier: Serve from the service line, closer to the net.
serve_toss.harder: The ball must land in the half of the box furthest from the net.
serve_toss.cue: Steady toss and ball hit high.
stepCues: From the right: toss in front of your foot, arm straight at contact.
Now from the left: same toss, same rhythm.
serve_toss.missTip: Three out in a row: toss lower and more in front, and hit more gently.
serve_toss.streakTip: Five in a row: now try to serve a little harder.

serve_first_pct.name: Ten first serves in a row
serve_first_pct.goal: Raise the first-serve percentage: a firm but safe serve, alternating sides.
steps: A serves 5 first serves from the right, then 5 from the left, twice.
Only the first serve counts: if it is out, no second serve.
Write down how many first serves go in out of 20.
The goal is to beat last time's score.
serve_first_pct.easier: Serve at 80% power, thinking only about getting it in.
serve_first_pct.harder: Every first serve out costs a lap around the service box.
serve_first_pct.cue: Firm but safe first serve: getting it in is what counts.
stepCues: From the right: calm rhythm, toss always the same.
Now from the left: same speed.
From the right again.
Last 5 from the left.
serve_first_pct.missTip: Three out in a row: take off a little power and think about the toss.
serve_first_pct.streakTip: Five in a row: now add a little speed.

serve_body.name: Serve at the body
serve_body.goal: Serve straight at the receiver, to take away room for the shot.
steps: Step 1: from the right, serve towards the receiver's hip.
Step 2: from the left, same target.
The ball goes straight at the body, not to the corner.
Count how many end up in the target.
serve_body.easier: Wider target, the whole central part of the box.
serve_body.harder: Someone returns: count whether the return is short or in the net.
serve_body.cue: At the body: take away room from the receiver.
stepCues: From the right: aim at the receiver's hip.
Now from the left: same target.
serve_body.missTip: Three out in a row: slow down and look only for the middle of the box.
serve_body.streakTip: Five in a row: now try with a little more speed.

serve_pressure.name: First and second serve as in a match
serve_pressure.goal: Serve under pressure: a strong first serve down the T, a safe second with spin.
steps: A serves 5 first serves down the T from the right, then 5 second serves from the right.
Then the same from the left.
Every second serve out counts as a double fault.
Write down the double faults: the goal is zero.
serve_pressure.easier: Second serves are served more slowly, with lots of spin.
serve_pressure.harder: Serve a real point: if the first serve is out, play the second and then the rally.
serve_pressure.cue: Strong first serve down the T, safe second serve with spin.
stepCues: First serve from the right: firm, down the T.
Second from the right: lots of spin, high over the net.
First serve from the left: firm, down the T.
Second from the left: loose arm.
serve_pressure.missTip: Three out in a row: breathe, slow the rhythm and toss always the same.
serve_pressure.streakTip: Five in a row: now try a slightly faster first serve.

return_block.name: Blocked return
return_block.goal: Return a strong serve with a short swing, sending the ball deep through the middle.
steps: B serves hard from the right; A returns on the deuce side.
A split-steps as B hits and blocks the ball with a short swing.
The return goes deep through the middle.
After 10 returns swap roles.
return_block.easier: B serves more slowly, or from the service line.
return_block.harder: A stands one step further inside the court.
return_block.cue: Short swing: block the ball through the middle.
stepCues: Split step when the server hits, then racket in front and short.
return_block.missTip: Three out in a row: shorten the swing even more and aim at the middle.
return_block.streakTip: Five in a row: now try to return deeper.

return_second_attack.name: Attack the second serve
return_second_attack.goal: Take advantage of the second serve: step into the court and attack with the forehand.
steps: B serves second serves from the left; A returns on the ad side.
A steps in during B's toss.
A runs around the ball and attacks with a cross-court forehand.
After 10 second serves swap roles.
return_second_attack.easier: B serves slow, high second serves.
return_second_attack.harder: After the attack the point is played.
return_second_attack.cue: On the second serve, step in and attack with the forehand.
stepCues: Step in during the toss, run around the ball and hit cross-court.
return_second_attack.missTip: Three out in a row: attack with more margin, depth matters more than power.
return_second_attack.streakTip: Five in a row: now try to attack closer to the line.

return_cross.name: Cross-court backhand return
return_cross.goal: Return on the ad side with a cross-court backhand, away from the server.
steps: B serves from the left; A returns on the ad side.
A returns with a deep cross-court backhand.
After the return, A goes back to the centre.
After 10 returns swap roles.
return_cross.easier: B serves more slowly, always to the backhand.
return_cross.harder: The point is played after the return.
return_cross.cue: Cross-court backhand, away from the server.
stepCues: Turn your shoulders early and hit in front, cross-court.
return_cross.missTip: Three out in a row: shorten the swing and keep more margin.
return_cross.streakTip: Five in a row: now try more angle.

return_lob.name: Lob return in doubles
return_lob.goal: Beat the net player with a lob return, when the opponents play serve and volley.
steps: B1 serves from the right, B2 is at the net.
A returns with a high lob over B2.
B2 tries to reach it moving back; if they can't, the point goes to A.
After 10 returns swap roles.
return_lob.easier: B1 serves slowly; B2 stays still.
return_lob.harder: A chooses: lob or low cross-court return, without giving it away.

volley_low.name: Low volley
volley_low.goal: Play the volley below the net: knees bent, open face, deep ball.
steps: A on the service line; the coach feeds low, towards the feet.
A gets down on the legs, opens the face slightly and guides the ball forward.
The volley must clear the net and land deep in the middle.
Series of 10.
volley_low.harder: After the low volley, a high volley to put away moving forward.
volley_low.cue: Get down with your legs, not with the racket.
stepCues: Knees bent, face slightly open and guide forward.
volley_low.missTip: Three out in a row: bend your legs more and open the face a little.
volley_low.streakTip: Five in a row: now look for more depth.

volley_reflex.name: Volley to volley
volley_reflex.goal: Reflexes and a steady face, both at the net.
steps: A and B one step inside the service line, facing each other.
Volley to volley, firm but controllable balls.
Count the exchanges without errors.
Try again to beat the score.
volley_reflex.easier: Further from the net, slower balls.
volley_reflex.harder: Move one step closer every 10 volleys in a row.
volley_reflex.cue: Steady face and racket in front.
stepCues: Racket always in front, short strokes and steady face.
volley_reflex.missTip: Three out in a row: slow down, the exchanges count, not the speed.
volley_reflex.streakTip: Five in a row: now move half a step closer.

volley_drop.name: Drop volley
volley_drop.goal: The volley that dies just after the net, when the other player is at the baseline.
steps: A at the net; the coach feeds from the baseline.
A blocks the ball with an open face and a soft hand.
The ball must land inside the service box, cross-court.
Series of 10.
volley_drop.easier: Bigger target, the whole service box.
volley_drop.harder: The coach runs forward after each drop volley: if they get it, the point is theirs.
volley_drop.cue: Soft hand: the ball dies after the net.
stepCues: Open face and soft wrist: absorb the ball instead of pushing it.
volley_drop.missTip: Three out in a row: less push, let the racket absorb the ball.
volley_drop.streakTip: Five in a row: now try to make it land even closer to the net.

half_volley.name: Half volley on the service line
half_volley.goal: Play the ball just after the bounce, while moving in to the net.
steps: A on the service line; the coach feeds a ball that bounces at A's feet.
A gets down on the legs and hits just after the bounce, deep.
After the shot, A keeps going to the net.
Series of 8.
half_volley.easier: Slower ball, bouncing one step in front of A.
half_volley.harder: After the half volley, the coach feeds a volley to put away.
half_volley.cue: Down on your legs, hit just after the bounce.
stepCues: Racket low and steady, guide forward and then go to the net.
half_volley.missTip: Three out in a row: bend your legs more, short swing.
half_volley.streakTip: Five in a row: now try to send it deeper.

volley_angle.name: Angled volley
volley_angle.goal: Finish the point at the net with an angled volley, forehand and backhand.
steps: A at the net, halfway between the net and the service line.
Step 1: angled forehand volley that leaves the court at the side.
Step 2: angled backhand volley on the other side.
10 per side.
volley_angle.harder: The coach feeds at random, forehand or backhand.
volley_angle.cue: Angled volley: the ball leaves the court at the side.
stepCues: Forehand volley: racket in front, firm wrist, towards the corner.
Now backhand: shoulder turned and face towards the corner.
volley_angle.missTip: Three out in a row: less angle, aim a little further inside the court.
volley_angle.streakTip: Five in a row: now tighten the angle.

swing_volley.name: Swing volley from mid-court
swing_volley.goal: Don't let the high, slow ball bounce: take it in the air and finish.
steps: A starts from the baseline; the coach feeds a high, slow ball.
A moves in and hits it in the air, with a full forehand, before the bounce.
The ball goes cross-court and deep.
Series of 8.
swing_volley.harder: After the swing volley, A goes to the net for a volley.
swing_volley.cue: In the air, without waiting for the bounce.
stepCues: Move in, get under the ball and hit a full cross-court forehand.
swing_volley.missTip: Three out in a row: hit in front, not above your head, and follow through downwards.
swing_volley.streakTip: Five in a row: now try more depth.

smash_bounce.name: Overhead after the bounce
smash_bounce.goal: On a very high lob let the ball bounce and smash from the back of the court.
steps: A at mid-court; the coach feeds a very high, deep lob.
A moves back, lets the ball bounce and gets under it, left arm up.
Deep overhead through the middle, without rushing.
Series of 8.
smash_bounce.easier: Less deep lobs, bouncing near the service line.
smash_bounce.harder: The coach decides at the last moment whether to feed short (smash in the air) or long (after the bounce).

lob_smash.name: Lob and overhead in pairs
lob_smash.goal: Train lob and overhead together: the baseline player lifts, the net player smashes.
steps: A at the net, B at the baseline.
B plays lobs; A moves back sideways and smashes.
B tries to get the smash back with another lob.
After 10 overheads swap roles.
lob_smash.easier: B feeds the lobs by hand.
lob_smash.harder: The point is played: B may choose lob or passing shot.

volley_smash.name: Volley and overhead
volley_smash.goal: After the volley be ready for the lob: move back and smash.
steps: Step 1: A at the net plays a deep volley.
Step 2: the coach feeds a lob straight away; A moves back sideways and smashes.
After the overhead, A goes back to the net.
Series of 6 volley-and-overhead pairs.
volley_smash.harder: The coach alternates volley, lob and body ball at random.

fw_cones.name: Cone slalom
fw_cones.goal: Short, quick steps and clean changes of direction.
steps: Five cones in a zig-zag between the baseline and the service line.
A goes around each cone with short steps, always facing the net.
At the end walk back.
Four rounds, with a pause.
fw_cones.harder: At every cone a shadow stroke (forehand or backhand) before setting off again.

fw_recover.name: Hit and back to the centre
fw_recover.goal: Get used to going back to the centre after every shot, right and left.
steps: Step 1: wide ball to the forehand, A hits cross-court and goes back to the centre.
Step 2: wide ball to the backhand, A hits cross-court and goes back to the centre.
The next feed comes when A is back in the centre.
Series of 8 alternating balls.
fw_recover.easier: Less wide balls and more time between feeds.
fw_recover.harder: The feed comes before A is back in the centre.

fw_body_ball.name: Out of the way of the body ball
fw_body_ball.goal: Get away from the ball coming at you with a side step, to hit a forehand.
steps: A in the centre of the baseline; the coach feeds straight at A.
A takes a step to the left, leaves the ball on their right and hits a forehand.
The ball goes deep through the middle.
Series of 10.
fw_body_ball.easier: Slower ball, slightly off the body.
fw_body_ball.harder: The coach feeds at random: at the body, to the right or to the left.

fw_forward_back.name: Forward and back
fw_forward_back.goal: Cover the court in depth: first the short ball, then the deep one.
steps: Step 1: short ball, A moves into the court and hits.
Step 2: straight away a high, deep ball, A moves back and hits.
Move back sideways, not with your back to the net.
Series of 6 pairs.
fw_forward_back.easier: More time between the two balls.
fw_forward_back.harder: After the deep ball, a third short ball.

fit_lines.name: Line sprints
fit_lines.goal: Speed and changes of direction: longer and longer sprints, back to the baseline each time.
steps: From the baseline, sprint to the service line and back.
Then sprint halfway between the service line and the net, and back.
Then sprint to the net and back.
Three series, with a minute of rest.
fit_lines.easier: Walk fast on the way back.
fit_lines.harder: Touch the line with your hand at every change of direction.

fit_shadow.name: Shadow strokes
fit_shadow.goal: Repeat the stroke movements without a ball, in rhythm, to warm up and fix the technique.
steps: A in the centre of the baseline, racket in hand.
Side steps to the right, shadow forehand, back to the centre.
Then to the left with the backhand, then forward for a shadow volley.
30 seconds of work and 30 of rest, 6 times.
fit_shadow.easier: Slower, focusing only on the technique.

fit_box.name: The service box
fit_box.goal: Move in every direction: sideways, back, forward.
steps: Four cones at the corners of the service box.
Side steps along the service line, then backwards along the sideline.
Side steps along the net, then sprint forward to the service line.
Three rounds each way, with a pause.
fit_box.easier: One round at a time, walking.
fit_box.harder: Time the round and try to beat the time.

tac_approach_pass.name: Approach and passing shot
tac_approach_pass.goal: Learn to choose the right approach and, on the other side, the passing shot.
steps: Step 1: B plays a short ball, A approaches down the line.
Step 2: A goes to the net, B tries a passing shot down the line or cross-court.
The point is played to the end.
Game to 7 points, then swap roles.
tac_approach_pass.easier: B feeds the short ball by hand; the passing shot is played only cross-court.
tac_approach_pass.harder: The point counts double if A wins with the first volley.

tac_middle.name: Doubles: down the middle
tac_middle.goal: In doubles a ball down the middle creates doubt between the two opponents and reduces the angles.
steps: Play doubles normally.
For the whole point pair A plays only in the central strip.
Look for the middle with the serve too.
Game to 10 points, then it is pair B's turn.
tac_middle.easier: Play only from the baseline, no volleys.
tac_middle.harder: The point counts double if it is won with a shot in the central strip.

tac_high_low.name: High ball and flat ball
tac_high_low.goal: Change the pace in the cross-court rally to take time and rhythm away from the other player.
steps: A and B rally cross-court on the deuce diagonal.
A alternates a high, heavy ball and a flat, fast one.
B must send every ball back deep.
After 20 shots swap roles.
tac_high_low.harder: A decides at random; the other has to read it from the preparation.
tac_high_low.cue: One high, one flat: change the pace.
stepCues: Alternate: high and heavy over the net, then flat and fast.
tac_high_low.missTip: Three out in a row: keep more margin on the flat ball.
tac_high_low.streakTip: Five in a row: now make both of them land deeper.
